title: Request your employment history from National Insurance records
text:
Use this form to get confirmation of your employment history to make a claim for compensation.

 You can ask HMRC for a record of your employment history if you’re making a compensation claim for:

 • an industrial injury (for example, asbestosis, industrial deafness)

 • a personal injury (for example, road traffic accident or fall)

 • medical negligence

 • another cause
